programme.title: Ragini MMS 2
programme.desc: Ragini's viral video sparks buzz. A sleazy filmmaker sets his next horror movie in the same haunted house-only to stir the evil that still lurks in its shadows.

programme.title: Khamoshi
programme.desc: In a haunted mansion, a mute girl confronts sinister spirits and hidden truths, fighting against fear and darkness to uncover the chilling secret of her past.

programme.title: The Xpose
programme.desc: Rival actresses Zara and Chandni; Zara is found dead; Ravi defends Chandni.

programme.title: Paltan
programme.desc: Lieutenant Colonel Raj Singh Yadav and his soldiers protect Nathu La Pass from Chinese forces, all while grappling with the emotional toll of being away from their loved ones.

programme.title: Jigarwala No 1
programme.desc: After Ranjeet is murdered by cruel landlord Dhurjan Singh, his brother Amar rises against oppression and faces a dangerous cycle of revenge and justice.

programme.title: Hero No.1
programme.desc: Timid Rajesh Malhotra Escapes His Tyrant Father And Meets Meena In A Foreign Land. The Two Lovers Decide To Marry, But When Meena'S Parents Object, Rajesh Decides To Win Them Over In The Quirkiest Way.

programme.title: Maaveran
programme.desc: Following a severe accident, a timid cartoonist starts hearing the inner voice of his superhero creation, empowering him to finally stand up against a ruthless syndicate.

programme.title: Makkhi
programme.desc: Sudeep, obsessed with Bindu, kills her lover Jani, who is reborn as a fly. Jani and Bindu team up to exact revenge on Sudeep in creative ways.

programme.title: Karan Arjun
programme.desc: Durga's sons Karan and Arjun seek revenge for their father's death but are killed by their uncle. Reincarnated years later, they return to fulfill their quest for justice and vengeance.

programme.title: Sardaar Gabbar Singh
programme.desc: The residents of Rattanpur are forced to face the wrath of Bhairav Singh, who unceremoniously usurps their land. They find respite when Gabbar Singh, a brave cop, takes on their oppressor.

programme.title: Tigers
programme.desc: Ayan, a salesman, takes on the multinational health care company he works, after realizing that they knowingly marketed a baby formula that's responsible for the death of hundreds of babies everyday.

programme.title: Welcome 2 Karachi
programme.desc: Two friends are kidnapped by the Taliban during a boat trip and end up in Karachi without their passports. Realizing the gravity of their situation, they desperately seek ways to escape.

programme.title: Detective Shivaji
programme.desc: Shivaji, a policeman, sets out to investigate a high-profile murder of a minister's son. However, while pursuing the leads, he must also deal with his own wife's death.

programme.title: Commando 2
programme.desc: A four-member team heads to Malaysia to retrieve money launderer Vicky Chaddha. The mission spirals into danger when one team member is critically injured, jeopardising everything.

programme.title: Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan
programme.desc: Bhaijaan avoids marriage to keep peace with his brothers. But when they secretly plan to get him to fall in love, everything begins to change.

programme.title: Baaghi 4
programme.desc: Following A Failed Suicide Attempt, A Man Struggles With Reality And Descends Into Turmoil. His Family Faces Uncertainty While A Concealed Truth Lures Him Into A Complex Maze Of Obsession And Love.

programme.title: Aadhi Sabdham
programme.desc: A Paranormal Investigator Is Employed By A University To Look Into A Series Of Mysterious Deaths That Some Are Attributing To Supernatural Causes.

programme.title: Simmba
programme.desc: Simmba, a police officer, works for Durva, a smuggler. His life takes a turn when he decides to avenge a woman who was assaulted by Durva's brothers.

programme.title: Ravanasura
programme.desc: Ravindra, an inept junior lawyer at a law firm, agrees to help a business magnate clear her father's name of murder. However, when bodies start piling up, Ravindra begins to show his true colours.

programme.title: Dil Dhadakne Do
programme.desc: On a cruise to celebrate their parents' anniversary, a brother and sister deal with the impact of family considerations on their romantic lives.

programme.title: Hamari Adhuri Kahani
programme.desc: After husband's disappearance Vasudha falls for Aarav, leading to conflicts.

programme.title: Madgaon Express
programme.desc: Three childhood friends plan a trip to Goa but encounter unexpected challenges and leading to a journey far from their initial expectations.

programme.title: Acharya
programme.desc: A stranger arrives in a corrupt village to fulfill a comrade's wish by ending illegal practices and challenging powerful leaders.

programme.title: Kesari
programme.desc: Havildar Ishar Singh leads 21 Sikh soldiers against 10,000 invaders in one of history's greatest last stands-where bravery, sacrifice, and honour rise far above impossible odds.

programme.title: Dhadkan
programme.desc: Akshay Kumar,Shilpa Shetty,Sunil Shetty,Mahima Chaudhry

programme.title: Badal
programme.desc: 1984 riots victim joins terrorist group, seeking revenge for family's death.

programme.title: Ek Deewane Ki Deewaniyat
programme.desc: When A Powerful Politician Falls For A Strong-Willed Superstar, Their Passionate Romance Quickly Spirals Into A Dangerous Game Of Obsession, Pride, And Heartbreak.

programme.title: Crocodile Island
programme.desc: Stranded survivors on a mysterious island battle ancient crocodiles and uncover dark secrets, racing against time to escape the deadly predators and the cursed land.

programme.title: Mr. X
programme.desc: After gaining the power of invisibility; a man becomes a vigilante, in order to take revenge on those who have wronged him.

programme.title: Peter Scot
programme.desc: A man hands over a large sum of money to two ladies, assuming they are sent to him by his employer. However, when he realises that he has been cheated, he sets out to look for them.

programme.title: Nanma
programme.desc: An immigrant labourer does all kinds of odd jobs to earn a living. His son gravitates towards the underworld creating discord in the family.

programme.title: Samoohyapadam
programme.desc: Vishnu gets acquainted with Raghu during a trip and learns that he is rich and returning home after sixteen years. Then, Vishnu pushes Raghu into a ravine and goes to his house pretending to be him.

programme.title: Pookkalam Varavayi
programme.desc: Five-year-old Geethu, caught between her divorced parents, befriends school bus driver Nandan and secretly visits his village, sparking a crisis that reunites her family.

programme.title: Moonnam Mura
programme.desc: Charles and his gang hijack a bus with politicians and demand the release of their colleagues from prison. An ex-police officer, Ali Imran, is summoned to solve the case.

programme.title: Thalayanamanthram
programme.desc: After marriage, Sukumaran's wife demands a glamorous lifestyle. However, Sukumaran, who finds it difficult to fulfill her wishes, takes a loan.

programme.title: Simhasanam
programme.desc: Madhava Menon, a respected village chief, faces trouble when a rival clan creates chaos in his village. Soon, his son steps forward to restore peace and order.

programme.title: Athisayan
programme.desc: Devan is an orphan raised by Maya. She's abducted before she can expose a high-profile group of criminals.

programme.title: Videsi Nair Swadesi Nair
programme.desc: A humorous story exploring culture clash, love, and identity, showing how values, traditions, and modernity shape lives and influence important human connections.

programme.title: Malavika
programme.desc: A tribal leader and British explorer team up. They seek gold in dangerous, mystical lands. Their goal is to defeat a cruel landlord. It's a risky quest.

programme.title: Sukham Sukhakaram
programme.desc: Alexander has the final word on everyone's professional and personal lives. When 1 of the family members elopes with a lover to end up in bad company, Balachandra Menon comes as a pilot to save the day.

programme.title: Pandu Pandoru Rajakumari
programme.desc: After the death of her mother and husband, Devu is taken care of by her father-in-law. However, her life takes a turn when she meets Appukuttan, a childhood friend.

programme.title: Malayogam

programme.title: Koode

programme.title: Malayalimamanu Vanakkam
programme.desc: Parvathy unknowingly falls in love with her uncle after taking her mother's place at his wedding, leading to emotional turmoil, unexpected revelations, and family conflict.

programme.title: Chamayam
programme.desc: Esthappan and Anto are two fishermen who do not get along well. However, when Esthappan learns that Anto sings and dances well, he requests him to perform in his stage plays.

programme.title: Sreeragam

programme.title: Onathumbikkoroonjal
programme.desc: Augustine and Gracy are happily married and have a daughter, Teena. Their life is shattered with the arrival of Dr. Vasanth. Who is he?

programme.title: Unnikrishnante Adyathe Christmas
programme.desc: Sophia has an argument with her parents over her marriage and leaves the house. Her parents seek the help of her close friend, Unnikrishnan, in getting her back in the house.

programme.title: Black Stalion
programme.desc: Black is a goon who falls in love with Laura Singh, a bar dancer. He tries to force her into marriage, but she stabs him and runs away to Kochi with her physically challenged sister.

programme.title: Vardhakyapuranam
programme.desc: Raghavan and Malathi face humorous struggles of old age, family conflicts and changing relationships while learning valuable lessons about life and love.

programme.title: Chakkikkotha Chankaran
programme.desc: Pradeep and Prabhakaran are brothers whose marriages are arranged by their parents. They are in for a surprise when they meet the women, who become their life partners.

programme.title: Kasmeeram

programme.title: Adayalam

programme.title: Panchagni
programme.desc: Indira is serving a life sentence in the jail and charged for the murder of Avarachan, a landlord who killed a young tribal woman after raping her.

programme.title: Vadhyar
programme.desc: A young man reluctantly becomes a teacher while dreaming of a flashy career in the metro. Torn between his aspirations and reality, he navigates the unexpected twists of life.

programme.title: Focus IV
programme.desc: Cop Bhanuchander dies at a guest house. Vijay Shanker investigates, suspecting murder. Vijay and Bhanuchander's wife, Suhasini, team up. Can they find the killer and bring justice?

programme.title: Kattile Thadi Thevarude Aana
programme.desc: Venugopal, an honest politician determined to curb mafia activity, is shot. He is replaced by his lookalike who becomes home minister, triggering dramatic political intrigue.

programme.title: Innanu Aa Kalyanam
programme.desc: The lives of college students Neelima and Aisha change when they befriend fellow students Karthik and Kunjumon.

programme.title: Out Of Office
programme.desc: The title "Out Of Office" is a play on their professional status, but it more accurately reflects their mental state. They’ve been "out of office" from their Mumbai lives for long enough to gain a new perspective. The episode focuses on the inevitable departure and the emotional weight of saying goodbye—this time with the maturity of adults who know exactly what they are going back to.

programme.title: Nero The Hero
programme.desc: The episode opens with a camera crew following Neerav Kapoor (Nero) as he prepares for his day. Within the first five minutes, it becomes clear that Nero doesn't just want to be an actor; he believes he is already a legendary craftsman who simply hasn't been "discovered" yet.

programme.title: The Tables Turn
programme.desc: The episode explores the concept of "Networking." Nero believes that his talent is so undeniable that if he can just get in front of the right person, the "tables will turn," and he will go from a nobody to a superstar. This leads him to infiltrate a high-profile industry event where he is, unsurprisingly, not fit.

programme.title: The Agony Aunt
programme.desc: Nero realizes that being a great actor isn't just about performing; it’s about observation and mentorship. He decides to take it upon himself to solve the "emotional blocks" of everyone around him, believing that his vast experience in playing fictional characters makes him an expert in real-world psychology.

programme.title: Superheroes
programme.desc: Nero becomes obsessed with the idea that he is the perfect fit for a "desi" superhero franchise. He doesn't wait for a script or a casting call; he decides to live the life of a superhero to "absorb the essence" of the character. This leads to some of the most cringeworthy "public" moments in the entire series.

programme.title: Getting Functional
programme.desc: Nero becomes convinced that the secret to becoming a superstar lies in "Physical Functionality." He decides that his body needs to be a fine-tuned instrument capable of any physical feat, leading him to join a CrossFit-style gym. However, in true Nero fashion, he doesn't just work out—he turns the gym into a stage for his "performative athleticism."

programme.title: In-House Talent
programme.desc: Nero is faced with a harsh reality: his bank account is empty, and his "blockbuster" hasn't arrived. He decides to grace a small-scale, in-house corporate production with his "legendary" presence. He views this as a charitable act—a superstar helping out the common folk—but the corporate team views him as a total nightmare.

programme.title: Reflections Of Blood
programme.desc: Nero decides that the mainstream industry is too "small-minded" to understand his vision. He takes on the role of Writer, Director, and Lead Actor to produce an avant-garde short film titled Reflections of Blood.

programme.title: Equal Rights
programme.desc: Nero realizes that "socially conscious" cinema is the current trend in the industry. He decides that to be a true "Hero," he needs to stand up for the marginalized. However, because it's Nero, he manages to turn a fight for "Equal Rights" into a self-centered campaign for "Actor’s Rights."

programme.title: High Is Well That Ends Well
programme.desc: The title is a classic Nero-ism—a mangled version of "All's Well That Ends Well," infused with his obsession with "vibrations" and high-frequency living. In this finale, Nero is faced with the ultimate test: a real, high-stakes opportunity that requires him to be... normal.

programme.title: All's Well That Ends Well
programme.desc: The documentary crew follows a rare moment of "crisis" in Nero’s life. His landlord has had enough of the "acting workshops" (noise) and unpaid dues. Nero, however, refuses to see this as a tragedy; he views it as the "Second Act" of his biopic where the hero hits rock bottom before the inevitable rise.

programme.title: Respawn
programme.desc: Arun (Vishal Vashishtha) is a former professional gamer, once known as "Flickshot," who left his passion to work a monotonous corporate job and support his family. When he sees his former teammate, Shekhar, succeeding on a massive stage, his suppressed passion resurfaces. Despite his father’s disapproval and the general stigma surrounding gaming as a career, Arun decides to quit his job and attempt a comeback.

programme.title: A New Beginning
programme.desc: Arun realizes he can’t win alone and begins the hunt for a new team. The episode focuses on the recruitment of a "misfit" squad: Prachi: A badminton player struggling with an injury. Jeetu: A delivery boy with natural, lightning-fast reflexes. Adil: A young, tech-savvy enthusiast who acts as the team's initial bridge. Raunak: A volatile but highly skilled "fragger." The task is harder than Arun anticipated, as he has to convince these individuals (and their skeptical families) that they have what it takes to be pros.99999999999

programme.title: Noobde (noobs)
programme.desc: The team has assembled, but the chemistry is non-existent. Raunak’s ego clashes with the other members, and the group struggles to put their personal issues aside during practice. Arun has to step up not just as a player, but as a coach, to teach them that in Esports, individual brilliance is useless without team synergy. This episode highlights the "grind" of professional gaming and the steep learning curve.

programme.title: Under Pressure
programme.desc: With the tournament only a week away, the pressure reaches a boiling point. Arun’s father discovers he quit his job, leading to a major confrontation. Meanwhile, the team faces a crushing defeat in a practice match against established professionals, leaving their confidence shattered. However, seeing Arun's dedication eventually inspires his father to have a change of heart, and the team finally begins to gel as a unit.

programme.title: Rise Of The Underdogs
programme.desc: The season finale takes place at the Indian Pro Gaming League. Team Clutch enters as the ultimate underdogs. After a shaky start and a brief internal conflict where Raunak almost walks out, the team reunites for a final stand. They reach a thrilling tie-breaker round where they must prove their worth. The series ends with the team securing a victory, using their prize money to chase their individual dreams while planning to build a permanent gaming headquarters.

programme.title: Rangbaaji (the Carefree Persona)
programme.desc: We are introduced to Raviranjan, a small-town guy who balances life as a part-time YouTuber with his status as a "full-time" aspirant. While he acts confident (his rangbaaji), the episode reveals the underlying pressure he faces. He isn’t just seeking a job; he’s seeking the social status required to marry Jyoti. The episode sets up the stakes: it's a battle between his dreams and the harsh deadlines of the competitive exam world.

programme.title: Parishram (the Effort)
programme.desc: The reality check hits hard when the OSC results are announced and Ravi fails his first attempt. He faces taunts from his family and the crushing weight of societal judgment. Encouraged by Jyoti, who provides both emotional support and a strategic plan, Ravi moves from being a "casual" student to a "hardcore" aspirant. This episode highlights the physical and mental "grind" involved in the preparation.

programme.title: Avroh (the Descent)
programme.desc: As the wait for the next exam cycle continues, the "high" of hard work starts to fade into a "low" (Avroh means descent). Financial struggles, family tensions, and unexpected "villains" in the form of societal gatekeepers threaten to derail him. Ravi is forced to make difficult choices between his relationship with Jyoti and his focus on the exam, as the cracks in his mental health begin to show.

programme.title: Prateeksha (the Finale The Wait)
programme.desc: The finale focuses on the most agonizing part of the process: the wait. Ravi faces his final hurdles and a major internal crisis of self-doubt. The episode serves as a powerful commentary on the Indian examination system, exploring whether a job title truly defines a person's worth. It concludes Raviranjan's journey by showing how he manages to reclaim his self-respect (Swabhiman), regardless of the exam result.

programme.title: Humse Na Ho Paayega
programme.desc: The episode sets the stage for the ultimate "Generation Gap" social experiment. Akash (Rohan Shah) and Pooja (Aditi Myakal) are a modern married couple living in a spacious Mumbai apartment. However, their lifestyle is outpacing their income, leading them to a radical decision: renting out their spare rooms to bachelors.

programme.title: Khan-Daan
programme.desc: After the initial adjustment period of the pilot, the household faces its first major logistical crisis—Food. The episode explores the chaos of shared groceries, differing diets, and the "disaster" that is a communal refrigerator.

programme.title: Safai-Squad
programme.desc: After weeks of living together, the apartment has reached a state of "critical mess." Aashna (Kriti Vij), who takes pride in a clean and aesthetic home, finally snaps. The episode follows the couple's attempt to militarize the house cleaning process and the bachelors' hilariously lazy resistance.

programme.title: Family Ban Gayi
programme.desc: The episode begins with a sense of impending change. After weeks of chaos, the experimental living arrangement—where a married couple (Akash and Pooja) shares their home with three bachelors (Rohit, Mohit, and Vishi)—is put to the test.

programme.title: Hotel California
programme.desc: Maya, a Gen Z UX designer, joins Thoda Sukoon — a mental health startup with strict office hours, long workdays, and zero breathing space. Expecting flexibility and support, she instead finds herself caught in a whirlwind of deadlines and old-school hustle. As pressure mounts ahead of a major product launch and funding round, Maya connects with her burnt-out teammates. But when it comes to challenging the system — who’s willing to speak up?

programme.title: The Launch
programme.desc: Tight deadlines. Zero chill. And one very fed-up Maya. Maya’s ideas get ghosted, her dedication’s under the scanner, and the team? Busy minding their own burnout. Just when she finds a bit of empathy, things spiral again. Sleep is a myth, pressure is real, and Maya’s had enough. But when push comes to shove… does she stay, or finally hit CTRL+ALT+ESC?

programme.title: All Is Well
programme.desc: Maya’s impulsive decision leaves her awkward around Chirag, who doesn’t miss a chance to tease her. As they open up about their generational views on work and life, Maya reaffirms her belief in mental health and Thoda Sukoon’s mission. But just as things start looking up, a bold move in a high-stakes meeting sparks serious tension with the higher-ups. Can Maya recover when her values put her at odds with the very system she’s trying to change?

programme.title: The Breakdown
programme.desc: While the team scrambles to fix minor app bugs, the real issues at Thoda Sukoon are swept under the rug — until it all explodes. An employee collapses from overwork, triggering a full-blown social media backlash. As tensions rise, Maya and Chirag are forced to face unresolved conflict, and the team must ask: how far is too far? Can this crisis spark real change in a toxic work culture, or is it already too late?

programme.title: The Cliffhanger
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Riddhi's collapse, Zooni spearheads a desperate negotiation for better working conditions. As a seemingly balanced work environment emerges, the team struggles to deliver, and blurred lines between professional and personal lives begin to fray. Are these simply growing pains for Thoda Sukoon, or are fresh, explosive complications on the horizon?

programme.title: The Misfit
programme.desc: India’s fashion matriarch, Zahira, is making a bold move - bringing Zahiraan into the world of wearable luxury. But there’s a catch - neither she nor her team knows how to navigate this shift. Thus, comes in Ayesha - a rookie designer, a dreamer bursting with fresh ideas. But will she survive the cut-throat competition in fashion and at Zahiraan? Get ready for an intense drama, glamorous showdowns, and career-defining moments as the battle for success begins at Zahiraan.

programme.title: Time To Shine
programme.desc: Ayesha’s out-of-the-box ideas leave a mark on Zahira, but not everyone is impressed. As she tries to navigate the high-pressure world of fashion, her bold creativity ignites a war with her team. Amidst the chaos, an unexpected friendship with Sanchi gives Ayesha the confidence boost she desperately needs. But in an industry where talent isn’t enough, will this newfound support be her key to a major breakthrough?

programme.title: The Big Launch
programme.desc: The much-awaited Zahiraan launch is here, but disaster strikes! One unexpected error threatens to crumble Ayesha's hard-won validation from Zahira, and jeopardize both their careers. Meanwhile, Karan battles crippling self-doubt, wondering if he'll ever measure up to the perfection demanded by the high-stakes fashion world. Will their reputations survive?

programme.title: Perfect Shaadi
programme.desc: Aditya and Prajakta are all set to tie the knot! As they navigate the excitement and chaos of wedding planning, a surprise guest from Prajakta's past arrives, turning their perfect day upside down. Will love triumph over unexpected challenges?

programme.title: Basundi Ki Bhasudi
programme.desc: As Aditya and Prajakta celebrate their pre-wedding festivities, a shocking twist turns their world upside down! Will they handle the chaos together?

programme.title: Hum Tum Aur?
programme.desc: A perfect wedding, a hidden secret, and a love under threat. Will Aditya and Prajakta's love story survive the test of time?

programme.title: Bride Ka Best Man
programme.desc: As pre-wedding festivities unfold, Aditya stumbles upon a secret only Prajakta’s best friend knew. Can he handle the parts of her he’s just beginning to see?

programme.title: Imperfect Shaadi
programme.desc: The episode centers on the wedding of the lead couple, where everything seemingly goes wrong. However, instead of letting the chaos ruin the day, the couple realizes that the "imperfections" of their wedding reflect the reality of their relationship. They choose to embrace the mess, focusing on their commitment to each other.

programme.title: Infection
programme.desc: The series introduces Nishant, Sakshi, and Huma as they begin their MBBS journey, adjusting to the demanding environment of medical college and forming new friendships.

programme.title: Diagnosis
programme.desc: A month into their studies, the trio struggles to balance an overwhelming syllabus, challenging practicals, and the desire to enjoy college life. An unexpected revelation about Nishant changes the group's dynamics.

programme.title: Top O' The Clubhouse
programme.desc: It's Saint Patrick's Day. Mickey and the gang are ready to celebrate! But when Pete's shenanigans threaten to ruin their celebration, it will take some help from Toodles, to get the party back on track.

programme.title: Homesick
programme.desc: Being sick is no fun for anyone, but Funny's sneezes are extra funny! Every sneeze sends Mickey, Minnie, and the rest of the gang through the wrong Adventure Doors. Will Funny ever feel better?

programme.title: Donald'S Stinky Day
programme.desc: When Donald accidentally rescues a cute little skunk, the grateful little stinker refuses to leave his side!

programme.title: Mickey'S Perfecto Day
programme.desc: Mickey and the Roadster Racers head to Madrid, Spain for some racing and sightseeing fun. But when a baby bull begins to chase them around town, their perfecto vacation starts to crumble!

programme.title: Ski Trippin
programme.desc: The gang is teaching Daisy to ski when she accidentally ends up in the middle of aa big skiing race! Using the skills she's learned along the way, can she pull off a big win?

programme.title: Hocus Bow-Cus
programme.desc: Minnie is launching her new 'Bows are Magical' fashion line. He forgot his bow tie at home, he rushes off to find it. Millie and Melody rehearsed with Penguini, but will they remember all the tricks?

programme.title: Minnie's Pet Salon
programme.desc: Minnie and friends get ready to pamper their pets at Minnie's Pet Salon! It's a spa day like no other for Pluto, Figaro, Bella, Butch, and Mr. Pettibone!

programme.title: The Case Of The Missing Sparkle-izer
programme.desc: Who's been using Minnie's new Sparkle-izer? When Minnie needs it to decorate her customers' bows, the Super Sparkle-izer turns up missing! It's up to Millie and Melody to solve the mystifying mystery!

programme.title: Always In Fashion
programme.desc: Minnie Mouse is always in fashion! She and Daisy love making bows at Minnie's Bow-tique. All of their friends want Minnie to make them bows.

programme.title: Blooming Bows
programme.desc: Minnie's nieces are very upset! The paper petals on their costumes are falling apart. Now, it''s up to Minnie to redesign the girls' costumes. But can she do it in time for the school's Posy Pageant?

programme.title: Bow-Bot Robot
programme.desc: Minnie and Daisy get some help from a bow-making robot in this retelling of an episode of Disney Junior's Minnie's Bow Toons.

programme.title: Easter Bonnet Parade
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! One day, a little puppy with nowhere to go arrived at the Main Street USA train station. Seeking for a place to call his own, follow along as the little pup explores the town.

programme.title: Trouble Times Two
programme.desc: Movie star Penelope Poodle has come to Minnie''s Bow-Tique to find something perfect to wear. But when Minnie''s mischievous twin nieces, Millie and Melody, come for a visit, it''s Trouble Times Two!

programme.title: Year Round Fun
programme.desc: Book with magnet set in a case

programme.title: Riches To Rags
programme.desc: A young boy is taken to work by his Papa and Grandpa in an old wooden boat. He discovers his family's unusual line of work and will decide whether to follow them or find his way.

programme.title: Blue-Ribbon Bunny
programme.desc: Sofia and her bunny Clover enter a pet contest. Other kids have fancy pets. Sofia must decide: enter with a fancy pet or stay loyal to her best friend, Clover.

programme.title: Clover Time
programme.desc: When Clover's warren floods, Sofia invites her to move in. They love sharing a room-at first. But Sofia soon learns that being roommates isn't always easy in this fun story!

programme.title: Just One Of The Princes
programme.desc: Sofia wants to try out for a spot on Royal Prep's Flying Derby team, but Amber, Prince Hugo, and her classmates tell Sofia that Flying Derby is not a 'princess thing.'

programme.title: The Missing Necklace
programme.desc: When the Amulet of Avalor goes missing, Sofia loses her ability to understand her friends. Longing to talk to her friends again, Sofia sets off to find it. Cedric is also after the missing amulet.

programme.title: Welcome To Royal Prep
programme.desc: At Royal Prep's Open House, Amber's special painting gets ruined by James! Can Sofia help her fix it before her parents arrive? Find out in this exciting story!

programme.title: Me And Our Mom
programme.desc: Sofia is so excited to spend the day with her mom at the annual Mother's Day Picnic -until she learns that Amber and James are joining too. Sofia wants her mom to herself on Mother's Day!

programme.title: The Curse Of Princess Ivy
programme.desc: In this beautifully illustrated eBook, Sofia faces grave danger when she faces Princess Ivy, a once-exiled princess who is determined to take over Enchancia and turn the whole kingdom black and white.

programme.title: A Royal Mouse In The House
programme.desc: It's the Enchancia Pet Show! Hildegard's mink, Lulu, runs away, and Hildegard turns into a mouse! Sofia and Clover must solve the mystery and reverse the spell before the show begins.

programme.title: Princess Sofia'S Busy Day
programme.desc: Today is another busy day in the kingdom of Enchancia for Princess Sofia. Join Sofia and see what an ordinary day is like for this new princess!

programme.title: Royal Fun
programme.desc: Life in Enchancia is full of fun! Join Sofia as she explores all the fun things there are to do-from dancing to joining the flying derby team and even spending the day at the Village Faire.

programme.title: Sofia The First
programme.desc: Sofia was a little girl who lived a rather ordinary life. But everything changed when her mother married the king.

programme.title: The Amulet And The Anthem
programme.desc: Sofia is chosen to sing the Enchancian Anthem at the annual Harvest Festival. After she becomes a bit too boastful, Sofia's magical amulet bestows a curse on her, leaving her all croaked up!

programme.title: The Enchanted Science Fair
programme.desc: When Sofia and her friends discover that they need to find a magical ingredient at the top of a mountain, they compete to see who can reach the summit first! Can Sofia convince her fellow students.

programme.title: A Time for Courage
programme.desc: Follow Mulan's courageous journey as she disguises herself to take her father's place in the Imperial Army, defending China against the Huns in this inspiring story.

programme.title: Honor For Father
programme.desc: Enjoy quick stories with Disney and Pixar girls! Join Moana, Helen Parr, and others on fun adventures. Perfect for bedtime reading in just five minutes!

programme.title: Khan To The Rescue
programme.desc: Mulan's grandmother is missing! Khan the horse alerts Mulan, who sees Grandma's hat and basket. Together, Mulan and Khan bravely search for and rescue her.

programme.title: Aurora's Homemade Holiday
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Listen To Your Heart
programme.desc: Pocahontas faces a tough choice. English settlers arrive, threatening her land and people. She must choose between her heart and protecting her village, seeking a path to peace.

programme.title: Raya'S Team
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Meet Raya, a lone warrior from the fantasy kingdom of Kumandra, and her mighty team.

programme.title: The Fight For Kumandra
programme.desc: It's up to Raya to find the last dragon and save the world of Kumandra!

programme.title: Raya And The Last Dragon
programme.desc: Raya, a warrior, seeks the last dragon to save Kumandra. She unites with a group to restore light and unity to their world in this adventure.

programme.title: Aurora And The Helpful Dragon
programme.desc: When Aurora brings a baby dragon from the forest. The little dragon tries to act like the other castle animals-a cat, a dog, a bird, even a fish-but something goes wrong every time.

programme.title: Meet Blondie And Berry
programme.desc: Meet Blondie, a pony with royal aspirations, and Berry, a food-loving bunny, as they form unexpected friendships with Rapunzel and Snow White in enchanting adventures.

programme.title: Meet Pumpkin And Bayou
programme.desc: An enchanting story introduces lovable characters in a whimsical land, bringing lessons of friendship, courage, and kindness through heartwarming adventures in magical settings.

programme.title: M is for Monster
programme.desc: Join all the monsters of Monsters, Inc. in this great alphabet book written by Mike himself!

programme.title: Incredibles 2
programme.desc: The Incredibles 2 movie, with fun and emotions, has a superhero family. In the latest chapter, Mr. and Mrs. Incredible, Violet, Dash, and Jack-Jack encounter a new nemesis who challenges their power.

programme.title: A New Mission
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Explore the life of a lioness and her cub on the African plains through this photo-filled storybook. Perfect for young fans!

programme.title: Pride Lands Patrol
programme.desc: Join the Lion Guard as they protect the Pride Lands, with fun animal facts from the Disney Junior Un-Bunga-livable shorts! Follow the word-for-word narration.

programme.title: Huey, Dewey, And Louie's Rainy Day Adventure
programme.desc: It may be raining outside, but that won't stop Huey, Dewey and Louie from having fun at Uncle Donald's house! The boys come up with some great ideas: painting, drinking hot cocoa, playing games, etc.

programme.title: Return Of The Roar
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Learn how the Lion Guard came to be in this beautifully illustrated picture book based on the upcoming Disney Junior movie event.

programme.title: Merida And The Missing Gem
programme.desc: Join the Disney reading. Merida chooses a beautiful brooch for her mother's birthday, but the pin goes missing, and she, with friends, has to search the castle grounds to find it.

programme.title: You'Ve Gotta Be Kitten Me
programme.desc: Mischievous kittens cause chaos and delight. Amid humor and playful troubles, love and joy emerge, showing how mischief brings unexpected happiness.

programme.title: Anna & Elsa: Olaf'S Perfect Summer Day
programme.desc: Summer is here in Arendelle, and Olaf is very happy! He loves summer days. This story follows Olaf as he enjoys his perfect day in the warm weather.

programme.title: Beyond The Palace Walls
programme.desc: Princess Jasmine has dreams that go far beyond the palace walls. When she ventures into the kingdom beyond her home, will she find the adventure she longs for?

programme.title: Puppy Trouble
programme.desc: Nanny takes all fifteen puppies to play in the park. One of the puppies, Lucky, can be quite a troublemaker. Follow along with word-for-word narration as Lucky makes his way of out of mischief.

programme.title: The Puppies' First Christmas
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Thunderbolt Patch
programme.desc: When Patch the puppy notices a mouse in the house, he pretends to be his TV hero, Thunderbolt the Dog and leads the pups on a wild chase after the bandit. Everyone will love the world of 101 Dalmatians.

programme.title: A Lion's Pride
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Explore the life of a lioness and her cub on the African plains through this photo-filled storybook. Perfect for young fans!

programme.title: A Friend Like Him
programme.desc: Few characters have Aladdin's singing, dancing, and joke-telling Genie's unique, irresistible appeal. This delightful picture book is ideal for any Aladdin fan who imagined having a friend like Genie.

programme.title: A Present For The Queen
programme.desc: Alice searches for a Christmas gift for the Queen of Hearts.

programme.title: The Coziest Carriage
programme.desc: When Scat Cat's home in the junkyard disappears one day, Duchess, O'Malley and their kittens come up with a new place for their pal! See how this family helps their friend when he needs them most.

programme.title: Beauty And The Beast
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Princess stories, little ones will fall asleep dreaming of fairy-tale endings and happily ever afters.

programme.title: Belle And The Castle Puppy
programme.desc: Belle gets a puppy, making Ottoman jealous because he misses being a real dog. He runs into the woods, and Belle and the puppy must rescue him.

programme.title: Belle And The Perfect Pearl
programme.desc: When Belle finds the Beast's favourite book, she sees that the leather cover is worn out. Belle decides to look for the missing pearl and fix up the book for the Beast as a surprise!

programme.title: Belle's Friendship Invention
programme.desc: When Belle sees a crowd gathered around a blue ribbon-winning invention, she volunteers to help the inventor-a girl named Simone-demonstrate how her machine works.

programme.title: Something More
programme.desc: Illustrated throughout with fantastic film stills this book presents an overview of the people, places, and creatures to be found in the magical tale of Beauty and the Beast.

programme.title: I Am Baymax
programme.desc: This is a comedy-adventure about brilliant robotics prodigy Hiro Hamada, who finds himself in the grips of a criminal plot that threatens to destroy the fast-paced, high-tech city of San Fransokyo.

programme.title: Baymax's Journey
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Follow Baymax as he travels through San Fransokyo in this charming storybook featuring word for word narration.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: Hiro, a smart kid, lives in San Fransokyo. A crime threatens the city. With friends and Baymax, a robot, Hiro becomes a hero. They must save their home!

programme.title: Fight To The Finish
programme.desc: Someone stole Hiro's invention and is using it for evil! Hiro must join forces with his friends and a robot named Baymax to save San Fransokyo before it's too late!

programme.title: Cars
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen takes to the track in three tales of speed! Follow along with word-for-word narration in this level one World of Reading reader bind up featuring Cars, Racing Days, etc.

programme.title: Driving Buddies
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, gets lost and finds friends in a small town. He learns important life lessons. Get ready for an exciting adventure!

programme.title: Driving School
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Mater must teach hot rod racers the rules of Radiator Springs. This story features characters from Disney/Pixar's Cars, promising a fun-filled adventure for young readers.

programme.title: Racing Days
programme.desc: Doc and Chick Hicks hold 3 races to see whose racing school is best. While Doc's student racers follow the rules, Chick's student racers bend them.

programme.title: Racing For Good
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Jeff Gorvette love to race, but there is one thing they love more: helping others. In this action-packed storybook, Lightning and his friends race to raise money to help old cars.

programme.title: Rally To The Finish
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater travel to the Black Forest for a race. Lightning is excited to race through the forest, but Mater gets scared when an old car tells them that a monster lives there.

programme.title: Roadwork
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, wants to win the Piston Cup. He ends up in Radiator Springs. McQueen learns that friendship is important.

programme.title: Francesco's Rematch
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his racing rival Francesco Bernoulli challenge each other to a race in Monza, Italy-Francesco's hometown. Both Lightning and Francesco are confident they will win the race.

programme.title: Mater And The Ghost Light
programme.desc: Mater the tow truck loves pranking his friends. But after he hears a scary story, Mater loses all zest for pranking. Now, he just wants to hide!

programme.title: Mater The Greater
programme.desc: Mater the Greater is a brave stunt performer who does many dangerous things in front of crowds. He jumps cars, flies through fire, and rides planes. Now, can he do his biggest stunt?

programme.title: Mater's Junkyard Jamboree
programme.desc: Mater can't wait to show his friends in Radiator Springs the junkyard jukebox he built, but they are too busy rounding up tractors on the loose-and the tractors are causing trouble everywhere they go!

programme.title: Monster Truck Mater
programme.desc: To become a world-champion monster truck wrestler, Mater must go through the ranks as a professional. I-Screamer, Captain Collision, and The Rasta Carian won't give up easily.

programme.title: Neon Racers
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his international racing friends are in Japan for the next leg of the T-ROC-the Transcontinental Race of Champions. But this isn't a normal race.it's a neon race!

programme.title: Radiator Springs Road Trip
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen's friends travel to California to support him in a race. They discover a rival is plotting against him and rush to warn him.

programme.title: Rescue Squad Mater
programme.desc: If there is a fire in Radiator Springs, Rescue Squad Mater is on the job! One day his best friend Lightning McQueen gets trapped in a burning building, and itis up to Mater to save him.

programme.title: The Best Present Ever
programme.desc: If there is a fire in Radiator Springs, Rescue Squad Mater is on the job! One day his best friend Lightning McQueen gets trapped in a burning building, and itis up to Mater to save him.

programme.title: Thunder And Lightning
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, the hot-shot rookie race car, is on his way to the race of a lifetime to claim the coveted Piston Cup. But Lightning hits a bump in the road along his journey.

programme.title: Tractor Trouble
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater want to relax by tractor tipping. They accidentally release the tractors! Can they round them up in time? Read along to find out in this fun adventure!

programme.title: Unidentified Flying Mater
programme.desc: Mater decides to teach it all his favorite things to do on Earth. But when the UFO is kidnapped, Mater must go undercover to rescue his friend.

programme.title: Race Around The World
programme.desc: All the world's a racetrack as superstar Lightning McQueen zooms back into action, with his best friend Mater in tow, to take on the globe's fastest and finest.

programme.title: Secret Agent Mater
programme.desc: Mater is a spy car and he has been instructed to catch bad cars! Follow along with word-for-word narration to see what spy life is like for Mater and his friends.

programme.title: Super Spies
programme.desc: All the world's a racetrack as superstar Lightning McQueen zooms back into action, with his best friend Mater in tow, to take on the globe's fastest and finest in DisneyPixar Cars 2.

programme.title: Back On Track
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Follow along with word-for-word narration and meet Lightning McQueen, Cruz Ramirez, and the rest of the crew from Cars 3!

programme.title: Rectangle

programme.desc: When Clover's warren floods, Sofia invites her to move in. They love sharing a room-at first. But Sofia soon learns that being roommates isn't always easy in this fun story!

programme.title: Just One Of The Princes
programme.desc: Sofia wants to try out for a spot on Royal Prep's Flying Derby team, but Amber, Prince Hugo, and her classmates tell Sofia that Flying Derby is not a 'princess thing.'

programme.title: The Missing Necklace
programme.desc: When the Amulet of Avalor goes missing, Sofia loses her ability to understand her friends. Longing to talk to her friends again, Sofia sets off to find it. Cedric is also after the missing amulet.

programme.title: Welcome To Royal Prep
programme.desc: At Royal Prep's Open House, Amber's special painting gets ruined by James! Can Sofia help her fix it before her parents arrive? Find out in this exciting story!

programme.title: Me And Our Mom
programme.desc: Sofia is so excited to spend the day with her mom at the annual Mother's Day Picnic -until she learns that Amber and James are joining too. Sofia wants her mom to herself on Mother's Day!

programme.title: The Curse Of Princess Ivy
programme.desc: In this beautifully illustrated eBook, Sofia faces grave danger when she faces Princess Ivy, a once-exiled princess who is determined to take over Enchancia and turn the whole kingdom black and white.

programme.title: A Royal Mouse In The House
programme.desc: It's the Enchancia Pet Show! Hildegard's mink, Lulu, runs away, and Hildegard turns into a mouse! Sofia and Clover must solve the mystery and reverse the spell before the show begins.

programme.title: Princess Sofia'S Busy Day
programme.desc: Today is another busy day in the kingdom of Enchancia for Princess Sofia. Join Sofia and see what an ordinary day is like for this new princess!

programme.title: Royal Fun
programme.desc: Life in Enchancia is full of fun! Join Sofia as she explores all the fun things there are to do-from dancing to joining the flying derby team and even spending the day at the Village Faire.

programme.title: Sofia The First
programme.desc: Sofia was a little girl who lived a rather ordinary life. But everything changed when her mother married the king.

programme.title: The Amulet And The Anthem
programme.desc: Sofia is chosen to sing the Enchancian Anthem at the annual Harvest Festival. After she becomes a bit too boastful, Sofia's magical amulet bestows a curse on her, leaving her all croaked up!

programme.title: The Enchanted Science Fair
programme.desc: When Sofia and her friends discover that they need to find a magical ingredient at the top of a mountain, they compete to see who can reach the summit first! Can Sofia convince her fellow students.

programme.title: A Mother's Love
programme.desc: Follow Princess Merida and her mother Queen Elinor on an epic adventure set in the Highlands of Scotland. When a beastly curse is unleashed upon the kingdom, Merida must try and set things right.

programme.title: Big Bear, Little Bear
programme.desc: Enter the world of Brave and learn about opposites.

programme.title: Oh, Brother
programme.desc: Meet Merida, a fearless princess with three siblings who are in trouble. Read and listen to the story to learn what happens when they transform into bear cubs. Will Merida rescue them in time?

programme.title: Merida And The Missing Gem
programme.desc: Join the Disney reading. Merida chooses a beautiful brooch for her mother's birthday, but the pin goes missing, and she, with friends, has to search the castle grounds to find it.

programme.title: One Perfect Day
programme.desc: Despite being instructed to behave like a typical princess, Disney's Princess Merida desires to practice archery, explore the kingdom, and be herself for a day.

programme.title: Cinderella's Best Ever Creations
programme.desc: The story explores how Cinderella must work to create a collection of dresses in a time-crunch. She creates beautiful gowns for girls and solves problems by creating an extra dress in a time crunch.

programme.title: The Great Cat-tastrophe
programme.desc: Cinderella agrees to help Lady Dupont watch the cats, Cinderella finds a clever way for them to lend a hand on her chores. Follow along as Cinderella and the cats tidy up the house together.

programme.title: Kindness And Courage
programme.desc: Ella's stepfamily is jeaous of her beauty and grace and tries to stop her from going to the royal ball. Will Ella make it to the ball and get her happily ever after?

programme.title: Moana Finds The Way
programme.desc: Moana sets sail on a great adventure across the ocean. Follow along with the word for word narration.

programme.title: Beware Of The Kakamora
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! While on their important voyage, Moana and Maui encounter the dangerous Kakamora. Follow along with the word for word narration in this exciting adventure.

programme.title: Moana
programme.desc: Mater is tasked with capturing suspicious vehicles because he is a spy vehicle! See what a spy's life is like for Mater and his friends by following the narration word for word.

programme.title: Moana And The Ocean
programme.desc: An engaging story about Moana's unique relationship with the Ocean that playfully interacts with stylized artwork.

programme.title: Our Perfect Stormy Day
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! When a storm hits the island, Moana, Heihei, and Pua head to Gramma Tala's for story time. Follow along with word-for-word narration as they all enjoy the perfect stormy day!

programme.title: Where Monsters Live
programme.desc: Moana, daughter of chief Tui, embarks on a journey to return the heart of goddess Te Fitti from Maui, a demigod, after the plants and the fish on her island start dying due to a blight.

programme.title: The Guardian Of The Dragon Gem
programme.desc: In Kumandra, Raya, a brave warrior, seeks the last dragon. She gathers a team to restore light and unity to their world. It's a fantasy adventure.

programme.title: Anna & Elsa: Olaf'S Perfect Summer Day
programme.desc: Summer is here in Arendelle, and Olaf is very happy! He loves summer days. This story follows Olaf as he enjoys his perfect day in the warm weather.

programme.title: Frozen 2: Welcome Home
programme.desc: Lieutenant Mattias returns to Arendelle after a long absence. Anna shows him around, revealing how much the kingdom has changed. He realizes that home is the best place to be.

programme.title: Outside My Window
programme.desc: For all her life, Rapunzel has been locked inside a tower. She has just one wish on her 18th birthday is to venture out of her tower to see the floating lights! Find out if her wish will come true!

programme.title: Simply Sadness
programme.desc: Inside Riley's mind, Joy and Sadness clash at Headquarters. This chronicles the effort of the five emotions to help Riley thrive.

programme.title: Boo To You, Winnie The Pooh
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! With this collection of spooky Halloween stories, little ones will be tricked and treated off to sleep with some of their favorite Disney and Pixar characters.

programme.title: Meet Treasure And Sultan
programme.desc: Disney Princesses love animals! Meet Pumpkin, Cinderella's glamorous puppy, and Bayou, Tiana's homesick pony. Discover their stories of friendship and adventure in this charming book.

programme.title: Quest For The Heart
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Moana and Maui set out on an important voyage. Can they work together? Follow along with the word for word narration to find out!

programme.title: One Amazing Chef
programme.desc: Remy, a rat with a flair for cooking, pairs up with young klutz named Linguini to make him a star chef. Follow along as Remy and Linguini work together to make the best food in Paris!

programme.title: Adventure at Skull Rock
programme.desc: Tinker Bell and her fairy friends embark on an adventure to retrieve the stolen Blue Pixie Dust from pirates in this Disney Fairies storybook. Follow the narration!

programme.title: Mowgli's Rainy Day
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Mowgli loves life in the Jungle. He gets to swing from trees, run through tall grass, and swim in rivers. He has many friends, wolf cubs, flying squirrels, and the rhinos.

programme.title: Finding Dory
programme.desc: This is the story of the friendly-but-forgetful blue tang fish as she tries to reunite with her loved ones, and everyone learns a few things about the true meaning of family along the way.

programme.title: Beyond The Palace Walls
programme.desc: Princess Jasmine has dreams that go far beyond the palace walls. When she ventures into the kingdom beyond her home, will she find the adventure she longs for?

programme.title: Puppy Trouble
programme.desc: Nanny takes all fifteen puppies to play in the park. One of the puppies, Lucky, can be quite a troublemaker. Follow along with word-for-word narration as Lucky makes his way of out of mischief.

programme.title: The Puppies' First Christmas
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Thunderbolt Patch
programme.desc: When Patch the puppy notices a mouse in the house, he pretends to be his TV hero, Thunderbolt the Dog and leads the pups on a wild chase after the bandit. Everyone will love the world of 101 Dalmatians.

programme.title: A Lion's Pride
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Explore the life of a lioness and her cub on the African plains through this photo-filled storybook. Perfect for young fans!

programme.title: A Friend Like Him
programme.desc: Few characters have Aladdin's singing, dancing, and joke-telling Genie's unique, irresistible appeal. This delightful picture book is ideal for any Aladdin fan who imagined having a friend like Genie.

programme.title: A Present For The Queen
programme.desc: Alice searches for a Christmas gift for the Queen of Hearts.

programme.title: The Coziest Carriage
programme.desc: When Scat Cat's home in the junkyard disappears one day, Duchess, O'Malley and their kittens come up with a new place for their pal! See how this family helps their friend when he needs them most.

programme.title: Beauty And The Beast
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Princess stories, little ones will fall asleep dreaming of fairy-tale endings and happily ever afters.

programme.title: Belle And The Castle Puppy
programme.desc: Belle gets a puppy, making Ottoman jealous because he misses being a real dog. He runs into the woods, and Belle and the puppy must rescue him.

programme.title: Belle And The Perfect Pearl
programme.desc: When Belle finds the Beast's favourite book, she sees that the leather cover is worn out. Belle decides to look for the missing pearl and fix up the book for the Beast as a surprise!

programme.title: Belle's Friendship Invention
programme.desc: When Belle sees a crowd gathered around a blue ribbon-winning invention, she volunteers to help the inventor-a girl named Simone-demonstrate how her machine works.

programme.title: Something More
programme.desc: Illustrated throughout with fantastic film stills this book presents an overview of the people, places, and creatures to be found in the magical tale of Beauty and the Beast.

programme.title: I Am Baymax
programme.desc: This is a comedy-adventure about brilliant robotics prodigy Hiro Hamada, who finds himself in the grips of a criminal plot that threatens to destroy the fast-paced, high-tech city of San Fransokyo.

programme.title: Baymax's Journey
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Follow Baymax as he travels through San Fransokyo in this charming storybook featuring word for word narration.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: Hiro, a smart kid, lives in San Fransokyo. A crime threatens the city. With friends and Baymax, a robot, Hiro becomes a hero. They must save their home!

programme.title: Fight To The Finish
programme.desc: Someone stole Hiro's invention and is using it for evil! Hiro must join forces with his friends and a robot named Baymax to save San Fransokyo before it's too late!

programme.title: Cars
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen takes to the track in three tales of speed! Follow along with word-for-word narration in this level one World of Reading reader bind up featuring Cars, Racing Days, etc.

programme.title: Driving Buddies
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, gets lost and finds friends in a small town. He learns important life lessons. Get ready for an exciting adventure!

programme.title: Driving School
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Mater must teach hot rod racers the rules of Radiator Springs. This story features characters from Disney/Pixar's Cars, promising a fun-filled adventure for young readers.

programme.title: Racing Days
programme.desc: Doc and Chick Hicks hold 3 races to see whose racing school is best. While Doc's student racers follow the rules, Chick's student racers bend them.

programme.title: Racing For Good
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Jeff Gorvette love to race, but there is one thing they love more: helping others. In this action-packed storybook, Lightning and his friends race to raise money to help old cars.

programme.title: Rally To The Finish
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater travel to the Black Forest for a race. Lightning is excited to race through the forest, but Mater gets scared when an old car tells them that a monster lives there.

programme.title: Roadwork
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, wants to win the Piston Cup. He ends up in Radiator Springs. McQueen learns that friendship is important.

programme.title: Francesco's Rematch
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his racing rival Francesco Bernoulli challenge each other to a race in Monza, Italy-Francesco's hometown. Both Lightning and Francesco are confident they will win the race.

programme.title: Mater And The Ghost Light
programme.desc: Mater the tow truck loves pranking his friends. But after he hears a scary story, Mater loses all zest for pranking. Now, he just wants to hide!

programme.title: Mater The Greater
programme.desc: Mater the Greater is a brave stunt performer who does many dangerous things in front of crowds. He jumps cars, flies through fire, and rides planes. Now, can he do his biggest stunt?

programme.title: Mater's Junkyard Jamboree
programme.desc: Mater can't wait to show his friends in Radiator Springs the junkyard jukebox he built, but they are too busy rounding up tractors on the loose-and the tractors are causing trouble everywhere they go!

programme.title: Monster Truck Mater
programme.desc: To become a world-champion monster truck wrestler, Mater must go through the ranks as a professional. I-Screamer, Captain Collision, and The Rasta Carian won't give up easily.

programme.title: Neon Racers
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his international racing friends are in Japan for the next leg of the T-ROC-the Transcontinental Race of Champions. But this isn't a normal race.it's a neon race!

programme.title: Radiator Springs Road Trip
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen's friends travel to California to support him in a race. They discover a rival is plotting against him and rush to warn him.

programme.title: Rescue Squad Mater
programme.desc: If there is a fire in Radiator Springs, Rescue Squad Mater is on the job! One day his best friend Lightning McQueen gets trapped in a burning building, and itis up to Mater to save him.

programme.title: The Best Present Ever
programme.desc: If there is a fire in Radiator Springs, Rescue Squad Mater is on the job! One day his best friend Lightning McQueen gets trapped in a burning building, and itis up to Mater to save him.

programme.title: Thunder And Lightning
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, the hot-shot rookie race car, is on his way to the race of a lifetime to claim the coveted Piston Cup. But Lightning hits a bump in the road along his journey.

programme.title: Tractor Trouble
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater want to relax by tractor tipping. They accidentally release the tractors! Can they round them up in time? Read along to find out in this fun adventure!

programme.title: Unidentified Flying Mater
programme.desc: Mater decides to teach it all his favorite things to do on Earth. But when the UFO is kidnapped, Mater must go undercover to rescue his friend.

programme.title: Race Around The World
programme.desc: All the world's a racetrack as superstar Lightning McQueen zooms back into action, with his best friend Mater in tow, to take on the globe's fastest and finest.

programme.title: Secret Agent Mater
programme.desc: Mater is a spy car and he has been instructed to catch bad cars! Follow along with word-for-word narration to see what spy life is like for Mater and his friends.

programme.title: Super Spies
programme.desc: All the world's a racetrack as superstar Lightning McQueen zooms back into action, with his best friend Mater in tow, to take on the globe's fastest and finest in DisneyPixar Cars 2.

programme.title: Back On Track
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Follow along with word-for-word narration and meet Lightning McQueen, Cruz Ramirez, and the rest of the crew from Cars 3!

programme.title: Oval
programme.desc: Oval takes kids on a fun, educational adventure to learn about shapes, especially the oval! With catchy songs and lovable characters, it's a delightful way to explore geometry.

programme.title: Circle
programme.desc: A young girl stumbles upon a mysterious circle that transports her to a magical realm, where she must solve ancient riddles and uncover secrets to return home safely.

programme.title: Feel Better
programme.desc: Join your favorite Disney characters as they help little ones understand emotions, stay healthy, and feel better with heartwarming stories, songs, and comforting advice.

programme.title: Five Senses
programme.desc: Explore the wonders of sight, sound, smell, taste, and touch with beloved Disney characters as they guide young viewers through fun adventures that celebrate the five senses.

programme.title: Let Your Smile Shine
programme.desc: Let Your Smile Shine celebrates the power of positivity as cheerful characters share joyful moments, spreading kindness and reminding kids how a simple smile can brighten any day.

programme.title: Keep Your Body Moving
programme.desc: Join energetic characters as they dance, stretch, and play in Keep Your Body Moving-a fun-filled show that encourages kids to stay active and enjoy healthy movement every day.

programme.title: Happy
programme.desc: Join your favorite Disney and Pixar characters and explore the feeling of being happy.

programme.title: Love
programme.desc: Love is a heartwarming tale that teaches kids about caring, kindness, and friendship through magical stories filled with lovable characters and beautiful life lessons.

programme.title: Sad
programme.desc: Join your favorite Disney and Pixar characters and explore the feeling of being sad.

programme.title: Surprised
programme.desc: Join your favorite Disney and Pixar characters and explore the feeling of being surprised.

programme.title: Diamond
programme.desc: When a curious boy discovers a glowing diamond in the forest, he unleashes a series of magical events. Now, he must protect the gem from greedy hunters and restore balance.

programme.title: Healthy Foods
programme.desc: Join Disney characters as they explore the world of healthy eating, teaching kids the importance of fruits, vegetables, and balanced meals through fun songs and stories.

programme.title: Bedtime Plan

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore’S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore’.Tagore’S Words And Basu’S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga’S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga’S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga’S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children’s turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn’t happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: CRIME FILES
programme.desc: It All Begins Around Us This Crime Show Explores Crimes That Occur Within Our Own Communities And Among People We Know. It Tells The Compelling Stories Of Ordinary Lives Disrupted By Crime, With Relatable Characters Representing The World Around Us. The Show’S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law’s. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law’s family.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel’s Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery; both personal and culinary. Ranveer’s passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.desc: The all-too-real chaos of exam season: the sleepless nights, panic Google searches, last-minute revision, family pressure and the weird peace when the exam sheet finally drops.

programme.title: When You Are A Dog Parent
programme.desc: The joys and weirdness of treating your dog like your child: the endless photos, checking if they’re okay when you’re away, the guilt, the silly little routines, the unconditional love wrapped in fur.

programme.title: Every Introvert Ever
programme.desc: This video comically depicts the relatable struggles and unique behaviors of introverts. It showcases situations like avoiding social gatherings, pretending to be busy to escape conversations, and finding joy in solitude, all while highlighting the inner world of an introvert

programme.title: Things We Did In College
programme.desc: The free-spirited college days: late-night chats, spontaneous plans, weird life lectures from friends, figure-out-your-future stress, tons of memories that become “remember when” moments later.

programme.title: When Your Sibling Knows Your Secret
programme.desc: That moment when your sibling drops a bomb–they know that thing you thought was buried forever—and the mix of panic, betrayal and relief that follows.

programme.title: The Boyfriend We All Deserve
programme.desc: A girl daydreams about the perfect boyfriend who gets her jokes, supports her quirks and is weirdly in sync with her mood swings. Reality then hits when she realises the gap between “ideal-boyfriend” and the human beside her.

programme.title: When You And Your Bff Are Complete Opposites
programme.desc: The one who’s impulsive and the one who plans; one loves the party and the other loves the book; yet you find a weird balance and strength in the fact that you’re totally different.

programme.title: If Office Were Like A Jungle
programme.desc: The wild ecosystem of office life, complete with predators (bosses), scavengers (gossipers), and survivors (you).

programme.title: Almost Shaadi At 4am
programme.desc: A hilarious “shaadi scene” unfolds in the dead of night when chaos, confusion, and last-minute wedding madness collide — because in every Indian wedding, something always goes wrong.

programme.title: Introvert Or Extrovert: Which One Are You?
programme.desc: The video humorously explores the quirks of both introverts and extroverts. It highlights their contrasting personalities and how they navigate everyday life.

programme.title: First Time And Girls
programme.desc: The excitement, nerves, awkwardness and bonding between girlfriends as they talk about/wonder about doing something for the “first time”—whatever “first time” means for them in that moment.

programme.title: Every College Romance
programme.desc: The coffee chats, late-night study groups that turn into deep talks, “let’s hang out” that become more than just notes swapping—and the inevitable chaos when love and exams clash.

programme.title: Thoughts You Have During A Haircut
programme.desc: As you sit in the salon chair you’re thinking: “Just a trim… keep it more than last time… hope they don’t mess it up…” — and your mind wanders. The video captures that internal monologue everyone has during a haircu

programme.title: A Day Without Electricity
programme.desc: How modern life collapses when the power’s out—no Wi-Fi, no AC, no Netflix—just panic, sweat, and forced bonding.

programme.title: If Google Were An Indian Aunty
programme.desc: The video humorously imagines Google behaving like a nosy Indian aunty. It highlights funny situations of over-involvement, unsolicited advice, and curious questions.

programme.title: Can Genz And Millennials Be Friends?
programme.desc: This video explores whether Gen Z and Millennials can truly be friends, highlighting their distinct traits and humorous cultural clashes. It showcases their differing approaches to work, relationships, and daily life, ultimately demonstrating how they navigate their friendship despite generational gaps.

programme.title: Awkward Moments With Your Crush
programme.desc: A compilation of hilariously cringe-worthy moments when your crush is around: the flustered smiles, mis-sent messages, the sudden silence when they walk in. All the awkwardness you try so hard to hide, front and centre.

programme.title: Lockdown Wala Birthday
programme.desc: The video humorously portrays what it’s like to celebrate a birthday during lockdown. It highlights missed traditions, creative adjustments, and the joy of simple celebrations.

programme.title: Every Long Distance Relationship
programme.desc: The late-night calls, bad network, missed birthdays, emotional reunions, and the constant tug between love and distance.

programme.title: Unlucky Moments That Ruin Your Day
programme.desc: The tiny tragedies—spilling coffee, missing the bus, dropping your phone—that somehow set off an entire day of bad luck.

programme.title: Every Office Bff
programme.desc: The video humorously showcases the special bond between office best friends. It highlights their gossip, support, and fun moments that make work bearable.

programme.title: What Moms Want Vs What They Get
programme.desc: A mom dreams of rest, praise, time with her kids — but she gets missed calls, last-minute pick-ups and zero sleep. The video uses humour and heart to contrast her wish-list versus real-life.

programme.title: Reality Of A Topper
programme.desc: Being a topper may seem like the ultimate dream—achieving the highest grades, getting all the accolades, and being the ""golden child."" But what’s the reality behind the perfect grades? The pressure, the expectations, and yes, the constant battle to stay at the top. In this hilarious sketch, we take a closer look at the life of a topper and what it's really like behind the shining medals.

programme.title: If Ekta Kapoor Directed Your Life
programme.desc: The video imagines daily life as if it were directed by Ekta Kapoor. It highlights dramatic reactions, over-the-top scenarios, and hilarious soap opera twists.

programme.title: The Razor Effect
programme.desc: One small action — like shaving / grooming — triggers a cascade of changes in attitude, confidence and how others treat you. The video shows how a little upgrade (razor, haircut) leads to big perceptions.

programme.title: Struggles Of House Cleaning
programme.desc: This video comically illustrates the various difficulties and challenges faced while attempting to clean a house. It highlights the often-relatable struggles of maintaining a clean living space

programme.title: Things Sisters Do
programme.desc: A sister-sister relationship: prank calls, borrowing clothes, fighting over the mirror, then insisting “I got you, always.” The video highlights the unique mix of rivalry and love sisters share.

programme.title: When Your Bff Is Leaving School
programme.desc: The bittersweet countdown: the late chats, the “let’s do something memorable” mood, packing up memories, and the quiet fear of “will things be the same after you go?”

programme.title: If Your Wife Could Hear Your Thoughts
programme.desc: A husband’s internal monologue meets the reality of his wife apparently reading his mind—every unspoken thought becomes a comedic disaster waiting to happen.

programme.title: School Best Friends During Lockdown
programme.desc: Online classes, missed canteen gossip, and the nostalgia of school friendships during isolation.

programme.title: When Girls Fall For Red Flags
programme.desc: A witty portrayal of how girls knowingly ignore every warning sign in relationships, convincing themselves that red flags are just “misunderstood.”

programme.title: When He Doesn’t Like You Back
programme.desc: You think maybe he does, you hope he might, you plan how you’ll act—but deep down you always know: the answer might be “no”; the video shows the sting of un-reciprocated feelings and how you deal.

programme.title: When Your Sibling Comes Home After A Long Time
programme.desc: The excitement, the over-preparing, the sibling rivalry resurfacing, and the joy of rediscovering the quirks you’d missed while they were away.
