programme.desc: This video humorously explores the various emotional stages people go through after a breakup, depicting the struggles and eventual healing process. It shows the journey of moving on and attempting to cut contact, highlighting the complexities of post-breakup emotions.

programme.title: guest in the newsroom
programme.desc: In this episode of Guest In The Newsroom, singer Lakhbir Singh Lakha speaks with Kuldeep Mishra about his musical journey and the stories behind iconic bhajans like "Pyara Saja Hai Tera Dwar Bhawani," "Maiya Ka Chola Hai Rang Lal," and "Are Dwarpalo." The conversation also touches on Khalistan, Sidhu Moose Wala, Daler Mehndi, Gulshan Kumar, and his views on the changing music industry.

programme.title: zero cricket knowledge
programme.desc: A beginner-friendly show from Lallantop TV that explains cricket fundamentals—rules, terminology, and basic tactics—using clear examples and light humor to help new fans understand the game. Each episode breaks down a key concept into simple, easy-to-follow segments.

programme.title: neta nagari
programme.desc: A new political alliance between Asaduddin Owaisi’s AIMIM and Chandrashekhar Azad’s Azad Samaj Party (Kanshi Ram) has added a new dimension to Uttar Pradesh politics ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections. On Neta Nagari, we examine whether the Samajik Parivartan Morcha can challenge Akhilesh Yadav’s PDA strategy and change the political equations in Western UP.

programme.title: lt insider
programme.desc: In this episode of LT Insider, Terence Lewis discusses his upcoming film Aaj Ka Mahishasur, his transition from dance to acting, and bringing the mythological figure of Mahishasur into today's context. He also opens up about his early struggles, his journey in the dance industry, and his experience facing the camera as an actor.

programme.title: kitabwala
programme.desc: In this episode of Kitabwala, Kuldeep Mishra sits with engineer and author Krish Ashok to explore the science behind everyday food beliefs, decoding myths about ghee, refined flour, and rice. The conversation is based on Ashok's book Masala Body.

programme.title: neta nagari
programme.desc: On this week’s Neta Nagari, Lallantop Executive Editor Kuldeep Mishra discusses Sonia Gandhi’s autobiography, Belonging: A Journey of Love, and the personal stories she has shared about the Gandhi family. The conversation explores her decision not to become Prime Minister in 2004, her relationship with Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi, and the story behind the book’s publication.

programme.title: the lallantop show

programme.title: Undertrial
programme.desc: Sagar Hussain, a factory worker, is falsely accused of and imprisoned for raping his own daughters. Later, when his lawyer digs deeper, the truth reveals itself to be much worse than imagined.

programme.title: Maqbool
programme.desc: In Mumbai's criminal underworld, the lord of all lords is Jahangir Khan (Pankaj Kapoor). Those loyal to him include Maqbool (Irfan Khan), his chief. But Maqbool is in love with Nimmi (Tabu), Jahangir's mistress, who convinces him to be ambitious and take over the empire. After maneuvering potential rivals out of the way, Maqbool betrays Jahangir, murdering him in his own bed. However, it isn't long before both Maqbool and Nimmi are haunted by the ghosts of their treacherous deeds.

programme.title: Sultaan
programme.desc: Don Kabira helps Ayesha in saving her garage from local goons. However, he hides the fact that he was an honest inspector sometime ago after which Ayesha decides to find out the reason for his transformation.

programme.title: Undertrial
programme.desc: Sagar Hussain, a factory worker, is falsely accused of and imprisoned for raping his own daughters. Later, when his lawyer digs deeper, the truth reveals itself to be much worse than imagined.

programme.title: No Problem
programme.desc: Raj is determined to lead an honest life and quit committing petty crimes. However, his friend and accomplice, Yash, always lands them in trouble and leads him further away from a crime-free life.

programme.title: Lucky-No Time For Love
programme.desc: A story of Lucky, a yound girl who is taken in by a wealthy family in Russia after being orphaned in war-torn Afghanistan . While adapting to her new surroundings, she meets a man who is initially distant and unapproachable, but eventually spend more time together and form a deep bond. Despite facing cultural differences and other obstacles, their love perseveres as they strive to be together.

programme.title: Ilaka (peddupettai)
programme.desc: Crime drama about Kumar, a man who rises from a slum to become a powerful figure in the underworld after witnessing his mother's murder. Driven by ambition and vengeance, he navigates betrayal and crime.

programme.title: Gandhi My Father
programme.desc: The turbulent and troubled life of Gandhi's son, Harilal, who at once tried to support his father's ideology, while simultaneously trying to create a life for himself, separate from his family name.

programme.title: Beti
programme.desc: Sudha assumes a recent acquaintance is the man she's being asked to marry and agrees to the match. When she realises her mistake it's too late, and she has to choose between love and family honour.

programme.title: Ram Rajya
programme.desc: Lord Rama returns to Ayodhya with his wife Sita after defeating Ravana in an epic battle. However, he exiles his wife when people start doubting her purity.

programme.title: Azaad Desh Ke Ghulam
programme.desc: When law student Bharti discovers that her father's wealth comes from illegal and immoral activities, she makes a deadly decision to escape that life and draws the attention of a plotting maternal uncle.

programme.title: Gaban
programme.desc: An unemployed son of an honest clerk tries to use his charm to con his way to a better life.

programme.title: Ittefaq
programme.desc: Dilip Roy is a painter by trade and, despite possessing a beautiful wife called Sushma, he spends most of his time painting. On the day of their anniversary celebration, Dilip is late finishing a painting when a frustrated Sushma snatches the brush from his hand. Furious, Dilip strangles her to death, is arrested and sent to a psychiatric institute.

programme.title: Do Waqt Ki Roti
programme.desc: When a notorious criminal breaks out of prison, Jailer Vijay resigns and vows to arrest him. However, Shankar, a brother set on avenging his sister's death, stands in Vijay's way.

programme.title: Param Dharam
programme.desc: Savitri believes that her illegitimate child with her deceased lover, Vijay, was stillborn and did not survive. Years later, Savitri's world changes when she learns that her firstborn is alive.

programme.title: Mithun Chakraborty
programme.desc: Get ready to groove with Mithun Da's greatest hits! From 'Disco Dancer' to romantic ballads, this collection is pure Bollywood retro gold.

programme.title: Best Of B R Chopra
programme.desc: Dive into these timeless tracks that shaped Hindi cinema's musical heritage. The golden touch of B.R. Chopra - where every song became legendary.

programme.title: Hema Malini Parveen Babi Hit Bollywood Divas
programme.desc: The Original Bollywood Divas! Hema's elegance + Parveen's sass = Unbeatable 70s magic. Press play for nostalgia in every note!

programme.title: Dance Hits
programme.desc: Pure nostalgia on the dance floor! Celebrate the vibrant sounds of old-school Hindi dance music with timeless beats and retro charm.

programme.title: Shahenshah Of Bollywood-83rd Birthday Special Vol 2
programme.desc: Iconic melodies of Amitabh Bachchan reflecting romance,pride, and cinematic brilliance.

programme.title: Zindagi Ka Safar
programme.desc: Dive into the emotions of life, with a collection of heartfelt songs that beautifully capture the highs and lows of life. Let these timeless tunes resonate with your emotions and experiences.

programme.title: Dilip Kumar – Tributes To A Legend
programme.desc: Celebrate the voice of a generation with songs immortalized by the charisma of Dilip Kumar. Soul-stirring ghazals, patriotic numbers, and emotional ballads that reflect a cinematic titan’s journey.

programme.title: Masti Bhare Geet
programme.desc: Feel-good songs to groove to. Perfect for boosting your mood and adding fun to any moment – pure, carefree energy!

programme.title: Blissful Beats
programme.desc: Soothing melodies that calm your soul. Let these peaceful tunes create your perfect moment of serenity. A carefully curated collection of rhythms to help you unwind.

programme.title: Harshit
programme.desc: This film is inspired by Shakespeare's Hamlet, written by Dhruva Harsh. It contains all the Shakespearean elements like, betrayal, love, hatred, revenge, sexual jealousy, poetic justice and dilemma of existence. Harshit is a protagonist synonymous to Hamlet, a Hindu boy living in a Muslim dominated area in Mumbai, India, loves Rahila, his neighbour. Later on fate plays a game in which two innocents, Harshit n Rahila are trapped.

programme.title: Pravaah The Flow
programme.desc: This story is about this Nature photographer Shivoham. Through his travel, he likes to explore and capture wonderful, breath taking creations of nature and places. But how can a journey be complete, without interesting escapades? 5 different locations, 5 different interactions revealing the darkest secrets, depth of life, deep hidden emotions and finally, ending the journey with an experience that leaves him all rejuvenated…as if he had a new birth and gets him all set for the next one.

programme.title: Gutargu
programme.desc: Gutargu is a romantic Hindi short story about a guy a girl who admire each other, and are falling for each other secretly. Their unusual love story takes place on a rooftop. Will their love story have a happy ending?

programme.title: Horror Chapters
programme.desc: Many horror events, interaction with super natural possibilities. Exploring the Paranormal

programme.title: Kamera
programme.desc: He is a 12 years old boy, who works in a garbage dump and lives in the slum along with his mother. Both have different ideologies towards life. He is a staunch believer of being positive and has a dream of spreading smiles. But, his mother is a frustrated woman. While working, he finds a digital camera in the dump. His friend tells him that people smile whenever you point it towards them. He soon realizes the same and gets all thrilled to spread smiles including his mother. Unfortunately, the camera gets lost and all his dreams get shattered. What happens next is the core of the film. The story revolves around the perception of a small kid who wants to follow his dreams.

programme.title: Hearts Awash In Sapphire Light
programme.desc: Hearts Awash in Sapphire Light unfolds the tale of two individuals who encounter each other one evening, initially under less-than-ideal circumstances. At first, they engage in petty arguments over trivial matters. However, as time passes, the undeniable power of their connection becomes evident, serving as a poignant reminder that sometimes, the most extraordinary journeys take place within the depths of our own hearts.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Hum Types
programme.desc: Charu, a girl from high society, faces her own struggles. One night, she meets Makrand, a boy from a low social class. Initially, their class difference creates a barrier, but as they spend time together, Charu realizes they share more similarities than differences. Through moments of vulnerability and connection, they discover their common humanity.

programme.title: Girgit
programme.desc: The film is an adaptation of Anton Chekhov's short story Chameleon. It tells a cheeky tale of injustice and corruption exposing the insincerity of public officials and selfish interests that aggravate or subdue their actions.

programme.title: Kajal
programme.desc: Like all elements, humans have a saturation point. What happens when a woman a constantly bullied by her boss, harassed by strangers and abused by her husband finds an abandoned package one night? A package that holds an answer to all her demons. A package that triggers an inner change in her the moment that she lays eyes on it. Kohl captures a turning point in the life of a woman, in a world claimed by men.

programme.title: Hey Listen!
programme.desc: After a few years of their breakup, Dhruv and Vidya finally got in touch with each other and decide to meet at the same place they used to hang out. All the memories were flashed, which lead them into a huge fight mixed with a lot of emotions that were buried within them years ago, and follows into an open end to the story.

programme.title: Abnormal
programme.desc: This is the tale of a mother who grapples with societal challenges due to her transgender son. She confronts opposition from her family and the broader community, yet resolves to safeguard her child's future. Eventually, she triumphs in establishing their identity within society.

programme.title: Jale Tere Honth
programme.desc: A young couple on their first date with the excitement of their first kiss does not find a private moment in the crowded city of Mumbai. Do they finally manage to experience that magical moment?

programme.title: Humari Khushboo
programme.desc: Khushboo a beautiful, young smart girl of 24 years has a medical condition that is associated with a social taboo, and her confidence is shattered when she ruins a Project Presentation in front of a prestigious and renowned client in her office. How she regains her lost confidence and fights against a social taboo, is the sort of stance HUMARI KHUSHBOO will take.

programme.title: Ghar
programme.desc: Isaac, a 15-year-old boy, is trapped in the trauma of his parents' separation, leading him to lose his passion for music. His grandmother advises him to revisit his passion and meet Naomi, a retired singer. How he finds beauty in his brokenness, follows the crux of the story.

programme.title: Keep Punching
programme.desc: Prior to realising her dream of representing the country, withdrawn boxer Kirnay must first fight the battle for her freedom outside the ring.

programme.title: The Friend To Die For
programme.desc: Can the girl survive, despite being abducted by a mentally unstable kidnapper whom society perceives as a serial killer? The truth may reveal a different story than what is commonly believed.

programme.title: Jaane Do Mujhe
programme.desc: Nisha is enjoying her date with Aditya, who was set up by her friends. While Aditya is in the washroom, Nisha hears a loud thud and rushes to check on him. She finds Aditya lying unconscious on the floor. Nisha contacts her friend Priya to inform her about the incident. However, Priya tries to reassure Nisha that it's all in her head and there's nothing to worry about. This raises the question of whether Aditya is still alive or if he exists solely in Nisha's imagination.

programme.title: French Date
programme.desc: Promila, a beautiful but lonely woman in a busy city, frequently on internet dating sites, meets Arun who's also stricken with a singlehood status for his whole life. As they both decide to spend some casual time together one evening. French Date, at first feels like a normal romantic story, which it is, but soon the viewer realizes something is different. The short film shall keep the grey matter in your brain active and you might find yourself on the edge of your seat.

programme.title: Kartavya
programme.desc: Aditi, once carefree, transforms into a responsible caregiver when her father suffers a paralysis stroke. Her newfound maturity surprises her mother. Six months later, as her parents suggest marriage, Aditi insists on finding a partner who accepts her and her parents. Will she find such a person in today's world?

programme.title: Freedom
programme.desc: Freedom is based on the lives of three women. All of them are going through the difficult challenges, which is made by society and their own family members. Despite living in democratic society lots of women still do not have permission to follow their passion or choose their carrier.

programme.title: Fried
programme.desc: In Mumbai, newlyweds Tanya and Rajat struggle after she loses her job. As financial strain and depression take a toll, their love is tested. An emotional journey of resilience, love, and the hidden impact of corporate layoffs on relationships.

programme.title: I Am Brampton
programme.desc: A city which never receives the credit it deserves, but comforts many new immigrants, with open arms

programme.title: Juwaa
programme.desc: Tillu, a struggling villager, gambles his wife's mangalsutra for a shot at change. Against the odds, he wins—but discovers the real gamble is just beginning. A tale of hope, sacrifice, and the unexpected twists of life.

programme.title: Haseen Rahasya
programme.desc: Raj, an AI engineer, has built an AI house operator Jyoti. Raj goes on a date with Sara. Sara, a chemistry teacher already having the experience of real- world experience, is icing on the cake. Everything goes smoothly. But the fun turns into fear when Jyoti says "Run to save yourself". Sara's talk with Jyoti turns the fairytale into a nightmare. What will Sara do to save her life?

programme.title: Loha Chor
programme.desc: A modest family from Haryana relocated to Dhanbad, Bihar, and took up residence in a government quarter that had previously been inhabited by the notorious "Loha Chor" gang during the 1980s in Bihar. The family encountered numerous challenges and social difficulties from both the local neighbourhood inhabitants and the remnants of the Loha Chor gang. Subsequently, law enforcement authorities conducted a raid on the premises. Through determination and courage, both the family and the protagonist of this story effectively navigated the situation in order to resolve the issue and find a resolution.

programme.title: Inphlembul
programme.desc: When two shady transport guys bicker over how dangerous their delivery consignment could be, they end up challenging each other’s a logic, knowledge, and sense of culture and language.

programme.title: Hmm
programme.desc: It all begins at a midnight bus stop, where a girl finds herself unsettled due to a stranger boy's attempts to comfort his girlfriend over a phone call. When his efforts prove unsuccessful, he starts conversing with the girl instead. Despite her apparent reluctance to engage, the boy persists in his conversation, much like a bee unwilling to leave a flower. As the night unfolds, these two unfamiliar individuals end up walking home together. Along the way, they delve into profound discussions about love and relationships. The culmination arrives in a meticulously orchestrated surprise, adding a climactic twist to their journey.

programme.title: The Exit Interview
programme.desc: The Exit Interview is a tense psychological drama set within the confined walls of a corporate HR cabin. The film follows Tanish, an employee desperate to break free from workplace abuse, only to be cornered by a relentless HR representative who refuses to let him go. Through sharp dialogue and escalating tension, the short explores themes of gaslighting, coercion, and the invisible scars of toxic corporate culture.

programme.title: The Scooter
programme.desc: The story, all names, characters, and incidents portrayed in this production are fictitious. No identification with actual persons (living or deceased), places, buildings, and products are intended or should be inferred. This is a work of fiction. Any resemblance to actual persons, living or dead, or actual events is purely coincidental. No person or entity associated with this film received payment or anything of value, or entered into any agreement, in connection with the depiction of any products.

programme.title: Raah
programme.desc: Raah is an exploration of the several stages of struggle when one steps out to pursue a dream. Sahir lives in Mumbai city with his family. The emotional and poetic narrative explores his faith, kinship and his struggle to establish himself as a poet/writer.

programme.title: Saas
programme.desc: After the death of a loved one, young Yatin takes on the responsibility of caring for his ailing mother-in-law. As he prioritizes her well-being, he faces numerous hardships, intertwining their lives unexpectedly.

programme.title: Arjun
programme.desc: Arjun is a soldier who works more like a mercenary in a never-ending war. He willfully follows the brutal orders of his commanding officer until one day, his entire world turns upside down. Examining one soldier's journey toward redemption, we show that our shared humanity is always worth fighting for underneath the trappings of all that divides us.

programme.title: Pendulum
programme.desc: After losing his fiancée, Vishu is drowning in grief, unable to see a way forward. On the verge of giving up, a mysterious encounter changes everything, offering him a new perspective on life. Will he embrace the second chance fate has given him?

programme.title: Make Her Happy
programme.desc: Nandita and Rahul are to be married soon. They are a live-in couple. Things take a U-turn when Rahul gets a call from his ex-girlfriend 'Suhana'. Will Rahul be able to save himself? Watch to find out who has trapped whom.

programme.title: Signature
programme.desc: A single mother, living in a small village, takes care of her little daughter’s educational expenses by doing tailoring work. One day, she receives a pension letter, for which she has to visit the Gramin bank. There, she encounters something unexpected.

programme.title: Oh My Star Wife
programme.desc: Story of a young married actress struggling with societal pressure over her fashion choices. Her husband's disapproval leads to arguments and a dilemma regarding societal acceptance. Ultimately, an unexpected accident brings resolution. Watch to explore how the protagonist navigates through societal expectations and challenges in her personal life.

programme.title: O Re Saajan
programme.desc: Sajan Tiwari', in his mid 30s, works as a small time estate agent in Lucknow. He is involved in an extra-marital affair. His only son, 5 year old 'Bunty', catches him in the act. Scared out of his wits, 'Sajan' makes every possible effort to stop 'Bunty' breaking the news to his wife 'Manju'. The story is a humorous take on small town life, relationships and family.

programme.title: Sizzle Of Shadows
programme.desc: A doctor encounters a couple suffering from Dementia, and attempts to alleviate their condition. Upon receiving a call from the couple's son who lives in America, the doctor visits their home and is shocked to find the couple arguing and displaying symptoms of Dementia. The doctor diagnoses the woman with Lewy bodies Dementia, which causes visual hallucinations.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Day Of Reckoning
programme.desc: John awakens from a coma to discover his wife and daughter were murdered in a brutal home invasion. Haunted by images of the attack, he vows to kill the man responsible: The fight pits John against Andrew Scott and an army of genetically enhanced warriors; meanwhile, he must contend with a Uni Sol in relentless pursuit.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Haywire
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Steven Soderbergh of Ocean’s 11, 12 & 13 comes HAYWIRE. A Female Assassin covert operative is hired to various global missions to perform jobs which governments can't authorize. When the operation goes awry, she needs to use all of her skills & tricks to escape an international manhunt and eliminate the last remaining link of the conspiracy against her.

programme.title: Out Of Death
programme.desc: From the producers of The Irishman & Lone Survivor comes this thrilling story of Jack Harris (Bruce Willis) who must tap into his killer instincts to survive the wilderness and the human predators as he tries to help a woman who witnesses a crime and finds herself running from a rural mountain town's corrupt police department after she took a video of police killing a drug dealer.

programme.title: Poseidon Rex
programme.desc: While searching for lost treasure, deep sea divers unleash a monster that causes havoc and destruction not only in sea but also on land.

programme.title: Bad Samaritan
programme.desc: Bad Samaritan is a terrifying thriller of two young car valets who use their business as a front to burglarize houses of customers while they eat. Their lives are turned upside down when they rob the home of a demented serial killer after making a shocking discovery of a woman being held captive. They must choose to run and hide, or face the killer whose dark secrets they have just exposed.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Regeneration
programme.desc: Terrorists kidnap the Russian Prime Minister's two kids, take Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant and threaten to blow up a reactor. Four Universal Soldiers go in but are no match to a Next Generation UniSol. The world's only hope is to reactivate decommissioned Universal Soldier Luc Deveraux.

programme.title: Love, Bites

Even to those who haven’t seen them together, since they like to flaunt the hickeys on their body. But something changes in their equation when the hickey becomes a bridge of memory that leads to an old sexual encounter Meghna had which Karthik finds out about. Will Meghna be able to help Karthik erase the marks of her past? Or will Karthik just to have to wake up to a realization that the past, even though it haunts, might not be real.

programme.title: Agarbatti
programme.desc: Bhola, who is mentally challenged but still manages to survive by himself, selling incense sticks on the roads. An accident takes place near bhola, he doesn’t see the person clearly who is driving the car. Will he be able to tell the police about this incident?

programme.title: A Situation
programme.desc: A widower father, Pradeep has adapted to the challenging life of raising a daughter single-handedly after demise of his wife. One fine morning, she undergoes menstrual bleeding while taking a bath. Helpless and terrified she is locked inside the bathroom, not answering her father. He does not understand what to do next. This film shows that even today, periods stand as the biggest question to a lot of parents.

programme.title: 10.30 Lets Go To School
programme.desc: Disha is an ordinary village girl with dreams like any other kid. Not only does she love her father unconditionally, but also her books and school. Life takes an unexpected turn when her Baba and Bua decide to discontinue their education. Her fate is about to meet that of thousands of other children who drop out of school every year. However, it is not so easy to give up. She is intelligent, confident and above all, determined to get back what she rightfully deserves, her right to dream!

programme.title: Bena
programme.desc: After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

programme.title: ABC
programme.desc: For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: Mukesh is a widower and has a 28-year-old so Rahul. They live together and rarely talk amicably with each other. Rahul thinks his father is too weird for his age whereas Mukesh thinks why Rahul constantly judges him for his choices.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Desh Ki Pardesh ?
programme.desc: The film follows the Parikh's on their visit to their children settled in the US. However, to only realize that there's a lot more than just a generation gap between them. After finding a wounded bird in the woods, a 12 year old brings its strange egg home, she hides it and keeps it warm until it hatches. The creature that emerges becomes her closest friend and a living nightmare. What has she been hatching under everyone's noses that shocks them all?

Based on the Internationally Bestselling novel by Kamon Nanami.

programme.title: Nefarious
programme.desc: A convicted serial killer on day of his scheduled execution gets a last minute court-ordered psychiatric evaluation. programme.title: The Deep Dark
programme.desc: 1956, northern France. One watchword: survival.

programme.title: Cold Skin

programme.title: Night Courier
programme.desc: From a struggling delivery man to the depths of a city's underworld, where desperation and opportunity collide, and this tantalizing opportunity comes at a great cost. Fahad a mentally fragile man racing against time must risk everything he holds dear, including his principles and the fragile sanity he clings to.

programme.title: Rememory
programme.desc: You can’t escape them. They’re everywhere. They bring tears to our eyes. They make us laugh. They bring us pain. Gordon a visionary inventor of the Rememory machine that allows him to see memories. He dies in his office. Is it murder? Sam investigates by using the machine "borrowed" from Gordon's wife. He looks at memories of others involved. REMEMORY is a noir mystery Thriller.

programme.title: The Deep Dark
programme.desc: 1956, northern France. When a group of miners are forced to take a professor underground with them for samples in the depths of a coal mine, they quickly realize that they are not alone and discover a crypt from another time, unknowingly waking up a bloodthirsty creature. One watchword: survival.

programme.title: Haywire
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Steven Soderbergh of Ocean’s 11, 12 & 13 comes HAYWIRE. A Female Assassin covert operative is hired to various global missions to perform jobs which governments can't authorize. When the operation goes awry, she needs to use all of her skills & tricks to escape an international manhunt and eliminate the last remaining link of the conspiracy against her.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Tekken: Kazuya's Revenge
programme.desc: Suffering from amnesia, a young man trying to discover his true identity is kidnapped by an underground crime organization and turned into a ruthless assassin

programme.title: Sky Sharks
programme.desc: Deep in the ice of the antarctic, a team of geologists uncover an old Nazi warship still intact where dark experiments had occurred. In order to conquer the world, the Nazis created rocket-powered sharks whose pilots are genetically mutated, super soldiers with supernatural powers who were able to fly & destroy

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Regeneration
programme.desc: Terrorists kidnap the Russian Prime Minister's two kids, take Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant and threaten to blow up a reactor. Four Universal Soldiers go in but are no match to a Next Generation UniSol. The world's only hope is to reactivate decommissioned Universal Soldier Luc Deveraux.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
programme.desc: Every 23rd spring for 23days, it gets to eat…Stranded on a lonely road, a school bus full of high school players must defend themselves from the Creeper, the winged, flesh-eating terror - ancient beast that resurfaces on the earth every 23 years to feed.

programme.title: Spytime
programme.desc: Anacleto, a former secret agent, is forced to come out of retirement and protect his son, Adolfo, when his arch-enemy, Vazquez, breaks out of prison and targets him

programme.title: The Free Fall
programme.desc: The Free Fall is a deeply personal horror thriller, a mind bending pressure cooker that constantly challenges us, hurling us towards one of the most shocking cinematic reveals imaginable. After attempting to take her own life, a young woman must wrestle with an overbearing husband and the only way out of this hell, is to fall into it.

programme.title: The Descent
programme.desc: Six girlfriends, a deep cave expedition going horribly wrong, suffocating miles under the surface of Earth, breed of predators smells their skin.

programme.title: The Descent Part 2
programme.desc: Refusing to believe her story about cave-dwelling monsters, the sole survivor of a spelunking exploration gone horribly wrong is forced to follow the authorities back into the caves where something awaits. The trapped group soon faces the hunger and savage breed of predators while trying to find a way out.

programme.title: Born To Fly
programme.desc: Two American F-35 Lightning II fighters enter Chinese airspace and cause havoc near the coast. Flying at supersonic speeds, the F-35s create sonic booms that damage an oil refinery and fishing boats. Box office smash hit & multiple award winner Born to Fly comes to life with special operations team headed by elite pilots who face death and challenge the limits of the sky and themselves.

programme.title: Consecration
programme.desc: After the alleged suicide of her priest brother, Grace travels to the remote Scottish convent. As she explores the wild cliffs and windswept beaches nearby, she uncovers what really happened with the help of Vatican priest, not only the murder but a disturbing truth about her own past which brings long-buried trauma to the surface.

programme.title: The Deep Dark
programme.desc: 1956, northern France. When a group of miners are forced to take a professor underground with them for samples in the depths of a coal mine, they quickly realize that they are not alone and discover a crypt from another time, unknowingly waking up a bloodthirsty creature. One watchword: survival.

programme.title: Nefarious
programme.desc: A convicted serial killer on day of his scheduled execution gets a last minute court-ordered psychiatric evaluation. The killer surprises the psychiatrist with his claim that he is a demon who wants the execution to go forward and claims that before their brief tie together is over, the doctor will commit three murders by day's end

programme.title: Butcher's Crossing
programme.desc: Butcher’s Crossing is an epic adventure journey of a team of buffalo hunters that follows a young Harvard drop-out into the Colorado wilderness as he joins a team lead by Miller (Academy Award© winner NICOLAS CAGE) in search of a mythic herd of buffalo in 1874. The journey puts his life and sanity at risk. The adventure will get horrific, confrontation with dark will lead to descent of madness.

programme.title: Warhorse One
programme.desc: During the 2021 US military withdraw from Afghanistan, a SEAL team helicopter is shot down by a group of terrorists. A gunned down Navy SEAL Master Chief miraculously surviving the crash, while the rest of his team killed in action must guide a child to safety through a hostile Taliban armed forces and survive the brutal Afghanistan wilderness.

programme.title: Bad Samaritan
programme.desc: Bad Samaritan is a terrifying thriller of two young car valets who use their business as a front to burglarize houses of customers while they eat. Their lives are turned upside down when they rob the home of a demented serial killer.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Avdesh' sister is surprised to see Gayatri and Indravadhan alive. She however makes up her mind to not miss the next opportunity she gets to kill them. Chandravadhan announces the commencement of the royal celebrations for the new year. As the function begins, Rajmata notices Sartaj. The two of them later discuss about a secret that they have been hiding all this while. Gaytari reaches the room and is introduced to Sartaj. Rajmata later meets Avdesh's sister and informs her that once Avdesh returns, she will have to leave the kingdom along with him. Watch 'Ek Tha Raj Ek Thi Rani' to know more.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: New Year party takes place in Raj Mahal and people celebrate it grandly. A guard meets Indravadhan and tells him that somebody who is near death has been brought to Raj Mahal. It is revealed that it is none other than Indravadhan's grandmother, Badi Raani Maa. Indravadhan's family is shocked seeing Badi Raani Maa, who confronts Indravadhan and apologizes for her crimes. Indravadhan's does not accept Badi Raani Maa's apology, instead, asks her leave the Raj Mahal. Will Gayatri stand quiet seeing all this? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Badi Rani Maa refuses to drink the water that Chandravadhan gets for her and calls out for Ranaji. Indravadhan reaches the scene but by then, Badi Rani Maa lays down lifeless. Indravadhan starts to cry out loud but miraculously Badi Rani Maa comes back to life and begs Indravadhan for forgiveness. Chandravadhan is delighted to have his mother back and he touches Indravadhan's feet and thanks him. As Badi Rani Maa is left alone in the room, Avdesh' sister secretly enters the room and all of a sudden, Badi Rani Maa gets up from her bed. It turns out that Badi Rani Maa had been acting all this while and is upto a big game. Watch 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani' to know more.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Badi Raani is playing a game of chess and claims that it is not time to play a move at once, instead, it is time to change the game. Gayatri tells Indravadhan that he should not punish anybody as a king and his duty as a king is to pass on judgment against the guilty. Raj Mata instructs the prison guard to not allow Indravadhan meet the prisoner under any condition. Later, Gayatri receives a note from Sartaj which asks her to meet him in privacy. Gayatri visits Raj Mata's court and finds the locket that Sartaj was talking about. She opens the locket and finds Sartaj's name imprinted in it. What will Gayatri's reaction be upon learning this? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri confronts Raj Mata and asks her to prove that whatever Sartaj is saying is not true. Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.
